selection.purpose: Web application test suites (warpdom docs/research/revision-plan.md item 13): real front-end applications, not libraries, whose unit/component tests run on jsdom, to check that results on the tuning and held-out corpora (component libraries) carry over to application code. Selected 2026-10-12, pinned to the default-branch HEAD at pinnedAt (corpus/apps-pins.json) before any measurement; warpdom was never tuned on these projects (treat them as held out).
selection.criteria: an application (deployed product, not a published library); tests on jsdom with Vitest or Jest (one of each preferred); installs from public registries without secrets; jsdom suite well under 30 minutes on a 4-vCPU GitHub runner with 2 workers; Node 22.23.3 (the corpus Node).

rejected.mastodon: moved from Jest to Vitest 5 (projects legacy-tests and a browser-mode storybook project); kept as a Vitest fallback, not needed
rejected.element-web: moved from Jest to Vitest (pnpm workspace with Vitest projects), so not the Jest application; a Vitest alternative to Excalidraw
rejected.superset, twenty: Jest applications, but engines require Node 24 and the suites are large (Superset runs Jest with an 8 GB heap)
rejected.mattermost, grafana: Jest applications whose suites their own CI shards across machines: far over 30 minutes with 2 workers
rejected.standardnotes: Jest application, but a 1.8 GB repository; wire-webapp fits better

projects.name: excalidraw
projects.notes: Excalidraw, the whiteboard web application (excalidraw-app plus the editor packages it is built from), Vitest 3.0.6, jsdom 22.1.0 (environment: jsdom in the root vitest.config.mts, default pool and isolation, setupTests.ts, sequence.hooks parallel). One root Vitest run covers packages/* and excalidraw-app: 143 test files, 2556 tests (47 skipped). Local (M-series laptop, 2 workers): jsdom 2508 passed / 0 failed in 111 s, warpdom 2507/1 failed in 96 s, happy-dom 2464/44 failed in 88 s. Vitest < 3.2, so ablation-isolation's warpdom-learned uses the emulation, not warpdom vitest run. yarn 1 (yarn.lock), no build step needed (aliases point at sources). Nothing excluded or patched.

projects.name: wire-webapp
projects.notes: Wire, the end-to-end encrypted messenger web application (apps/webapp, an Nx monorepo with the libraries it is built from), Jest 30.5.2 with jest-environment-jsdom 30.5.2 (jsdom 29.1.1 at the root), testEnvironment jsdom, @swc/jest and babel-jest transforms. At the pinned commit: 589 test files, about 4945 tests (19 skipped). Environment comparison, untraced (local, 2 workers): jsdom 4926 passed / 0 failed in 80 s, warpdom 4785/2 failed in 88 s (139 fewer tests collected: 3 files fail), happy-dom 4854/50 failed in 162 s. Install and build there: yarn 4 (yarn install --immutable, picked from yarn.lock + .yarnrc.yml) and the build step builds the *-lib Nx projects (yarn nx run-many). Upstream moved to npm workspaces with a package-lock.json in 51cfd7f (2026-10-22, packageManager npm@11.x; yarn under Corepack then refuses the project) and moved routine builds to Just in c3896787f (2026-10-28, upstream CI: npm clean-install, then npx just build-libraries and npx just test-ci). fb16c2bf0 (2026-10-29) removed the root postinstall (patch-package and configure-webapp now run as just setup after npm clean-install), and ac32e0203 (2026-10-29, Require Node.js 26 and npm 11) added devEngines with runtime node >=26.12.1 <27 and packageManager npm >=11.20.0 <12, both onFail error. npm (10.9.9 bundled with Node 22.23.3) checks devEngines before every local command, npx included, and --force is its only override (it downgrades the errors to warnings; with a lockfile it otherwise only skips the platform check for non-optional packages, optional native binaries are still filtered). So install and build both branch on yarn.lock: with it, yarn install --immutable and the Nx build as before; without it (upstream head), npm ci --force, then the local just binary (node_modules/.bin/just, the rust-just devDependency, not npx, which would hit the same devEngines error) runs setup and build-libraries (tsc in each library). Either way the setup step clones the public github.com/wireapp/wire-web-config-default (git, no credentials). The tests import the workspace libraries' built output (lib/), so only the libraries are built (not the app bundle). At upstream head ef483f526 (2026-10-29), Node 22.23.3, 2 workers: 616 test files, 5183 tests (19 skipped), jsdom 5164 passed / 0 failed in 99 s; traced run identical (5164/5183, 108 s). Upstream requires Node 26 since ac32e0203, but the only source change there is a type import (TextEncoderEncodeIntoResult), and install, build and tests run on Node 22.23.3. Only apps/webapp's Jest suite is measured (apps/server and the libraries' own tests are node-environment or not application UI). Nothing patched.
projects.install: if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn install --immutable; else npm ci --force; fi
projects.build: if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_DAEMON=false yarn nx run-many -t build --projects='*-lib'; else node_modules/.bin/just setup && node_modules/.bin/just build-libraries; fi
